title: Go: SemVer System
description: Build a Semantic Versioning library for parsing, comparing, sorting, and range matching.

steps.title: Parse version string
steps.description: Define a `Version` struct with `Major, Minor, Patch int`, `Prerelease string`, and `BuildMetadata string`. Implement `Parse(v string) (Version, error)` using `fmt.Sscanf` or `strings.Split`. Print the parsed version of `"1.2.3"` with `fmt.Printf("%d.%d.%d", v.Major, v.Minor, v.Patch)`.
hints: Split on `-` for prerelease, `+` for build metadata after the patch.
Return an error if the string does not match the pattern.

verification.failureMessage: Parse('1.2.3') should produce Major=1, Minor=2, Patch=3.

steps.title: Compare method
steps.description: Implement `(v Version) Compare(other Version) int` returning -1, 0, or 1. SemVer precedence: major > minor > patch > prerelease (pre-release has lower precedence). Print the comparison of `"1.0.0"` vs `"2.0.0"` and `"1.0.0-alpha"` vs `"1.0.0"`.
hints: Compare major first, then minor, then patch.
Prerelease versions have lower precedence than release (no prerelease).
Prerelease comparison: split by `.`, compare numeric fields numerically, strings lexicographically.

steps.title: Sort versions
steps.description: Implement `Sort(versions []Version)` using `sort.Slice` with your `Compare` method. Parse `["1.0.0", "0.9.0", "2.0.0"]`, sort, and print each version on its own line with `fmt.Println(v.String())`.
hints: Use `sort.Slice(versions, func(i, j int) bool { return versions[i].Compare(versions[j]) < 0 })`.
Print each sorted version on a separate line.

steps.title: Caret and tilde range parsing
steps.description: Parse caret `^1.2.3` (compatible with >=1.2.3 <2.0.0) and tilde `~1.2.3` (approximately >=1.2.3 <1.3.0) ranges. Define `Range` struct with `min, max Version` and `includeMin, includeMax bool`. Print the bounds of `^1.2.3` and `~1.2.3`.
hints: Parse `^` prefix: set min = parsed, max = (major+1).0.0, includeMin=true, includeMax=false.
Parse `~` prefix: min = parsed, max = major.minor+1.0, includeMin=true, includeMax=false.
Use a simple first-char check to detect range type.

verification.successMessage: Caret and tilde ranges parsed correctly.

steps.title: Range satisfies check
steps.description: Implement `(r Range) Satisfies(v Version) bool` that checks if `v` falls within the range. Test with `^1.2.3` — `1.5.0` should satisfy, `2.0.0` should not. Print `"true"` or `"false"` for each check.
hints: Compare v against min and max using the Compare method.
Return false if v is below min or above/equal to max (depending on includeMax).

steps.title: Prerelease sorting
steps.description: Implement proper prerelease sorting per SemVer spec: numeric identifiers compare numerically, alphanumeric compare lexicographically. Parse `["1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-alpha.1", "1.0.0-alpha.beta", "1.0.0-beta"]`, sort, and print each.
hints: Split prerelease by `.` and compare field by field.
Numeric fields: convert to int and compare; string fields: lexicographic.
Identifiers with only digits are numeric; otherwise they're strings.

verification.successMessage: Prerelease versions sorted per SemVer spec.
